page_title: HAV 2-1 TOU | Le Havre v Toulouse 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
90+3' Toulouse have a corner.
90+3' Toulouse force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A yellow card for bad language! Lionel Mpasi-Nzau (Le Havre) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
88' A yellow card for a tackle by Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse). Jerome Brisard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
84' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Timothee Pembele.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Djibril Sidibe.
83' Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
80' The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Now Toulouse have a corner.
79' Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' Celebrations are cut short for Toulouse as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
76' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Toulouse can stand using VAR.
76' It is in the back of the net! Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) coolly beats the goalkeeper.
70' The foul by Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jerome Brisard.
67' Good work from Toulouse as they win a corner.
66' The linesman points to the corner flag, Toulouse are going to take it.
65' A substitution has been made. Simon Ebonog goes off and Ally Samatta (Le Havre) comes on.
65' Here's the change. Sofiane Boufal leaves the pitch and Daren Nbenbege Mosengo (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
62' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Emersonn and he is replaced by Jacen Russell-Rowe (Toulouse).
62' Substitution. Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rasmus Nicolaisen walks off.
62' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Cristian Casseres is replaced by Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
59' 4:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
58' Le Havre players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
55' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Simon Ebonog (Le Havre), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
54' Jerome Brisard shows the yellow card to Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) for a heavy challenge.
53' 2 - 1 Goal! Issa Soumare (Le Havre) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Sofiane Boufal, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
52' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
51' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
51' Toulouse control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Didier Digard probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mory Diaw (Le Havre). He is replaced by Lionel Mpasi-Nzau.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' The game is interrupted now, Mory Diaw (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+3' 1 - 1 Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires home. His effort goes inside the left post and hits the net.
45+3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 0 Goal! Issa Soumare (Le Havre) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Guillaume Restes had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
42' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Mory Diaw (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

37' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the top right corner. Mory Diaw guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
36' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle after Issa Soumare (Le Havre) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
34' Mory Diaw (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Substitution. Rafik Messali makes his way off the pitch and Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) comes on as his replacement.
28' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Le Havre.
24' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
21' Ball possession – 37:63.

17' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Mory Diaw!
12' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' The ball is out of play and the goal kick will be taken by Mory Diaw (Le Havre).
9' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Toulouse.
6' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is shown a red card by the referee for a horror tackle that simply has no place in football!
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
